guard: a started seat's cotal_spawn result says where it is and the next move, naming only the join the caller passed (#5490)
why: Fresh agents spawned helpers nobody could reach on a channel, and the result only said the seat
R1 drops the join channels from the line, and R6 stops the tool passing them, so a helper put on
the task's channel is not said to be there. R2 claims a seat with no join is on no channel, which
is false for a persona that lists subscribe. R3 hides a rename. R4 says a seat waiting at an
operator screen is on its channel before it has joined the mesh. R5 tells the spawner to despawn a
once seat its manager stops. Each is its own cell.
NO BUILD STEP: the suite imports ../src.

mutations.name: R1 the line drops the join channels
mutations.expectRed: a spawn with join names the channel, where the brief goes, when to mention it and to despawn it
mutations.cell: a spawn with join names the channel, where the brief goes, when to mention it and to despawn it
mutations.note: The spawner would not be told where to post the brief.

mutations.name: R2 a seat with no join is said to be on no channel
mutations.find: const persona = "it starts only on the channels its persona lists, which may be none";
mutations.replace: const persona = "it starts on no channel";
mutations.expectRed: a spawn without join says the seat has only its persona's channels and names join
mutations.cell: a spawn without join says the seat has only its persona's channels and names join
mutations.note: A persona that lists subscribe starts on those channels, so the claim would be false for it.

mutations.name: R3 a rename no longer leads the line
mutations.expectRed: a renamed seat leads with the name it got and the name that was taken
mutations.cell: a renamed seat leads with the name it got and the name that was taken
mutations.note: The spawner would address the name it asked for, which belongs to another seat.

mutations.name: R4 a seat waiting for the operator is reported like a joined one
mutations.expectRed: a seat waiting for the operator says it has not joined the mesh yet
mutations.cell: a seat waiting for the operator says it has not joined the mesh yet
mutations.note: The spawner would post the brief for a seat that is still at Claude's session picker.

mutations.name: R5 a once seat is told to be despawned
mutations.find: ${s.once ? "" : " Despawn it when its job is done."}
mutations.replace: Despawn it when its job is done.
mutations.expectRed: a once seat is not told to be despawned, since its manager stops it
mutations.cell: a once seat is not told to be despawned, since its manager stops it
mutations.note: A once seat is stopped when its task ends; a despawn then races the manager's own stop.

mutations.name: R6 the tool stops passing join to the line
mutations.find: mode, model: d?.model, join, waitingFor: d?.waitingFor,
mutations.replace: mode, model: d?.model, join: undefined, waitingFor: d?.waitingFor,
mutations.expectRed: a spawn with join names the channel, where the brief goes, when to mention it and to despawn it
mutations.cell: a spawn with join names the channel, where the brief goes, when to mention it and to despawn it
mutations.note: The line is right only if the tool hands it the join the caller passed.
